lines.en: The seeds in this pot are starting to sprout.
Wow! When did you plant them, Grandma?
I planted them three weeks ago.
Can I dig here for the new plant?
lines.ko: 새 모종을 심게 여기를 파도 돼요?

lines.en: Yes. Please take the small shovel.
There are many weeds by the fence.
Pull them out, and I will trim the tree.
lines.ko: 그건 뽑아 주세요, 나무는 제가 다듬을게요.

lines.en: Where is the rake, Grandma?
Behind the door. Bring the hose too, please.
lines.ko: 문 뒤에 있어요. 호스도 같이 가져와요.

lines.en: Okay. I will water the flowers after lunch.
lines.ko: 알겠어요. 점심 먹고 꽃에 물을 줄게요.

dialogs.about: 울타리 너머로 이웃과 정원 이야기를 나눔

lines.en: Hello! Your garden looks beautiful this year.
Thank you. The roses have many buds now.
How do you stop all the weeds?
I dig them out every Saturday morning.
Can I borrow your rake and shovel?
lines.ko: 갈퀴랑 삽 좀 빌릴 수 있을까요?

lines.en: Of course. They are behind the fence.
Thank you. I lost mine last month.
Will you trim your tall tree soon?
lines.ko: 키 큰 나무는 곧 다듬으실 거예요?

lines.en: Yes. I will use a hose after that.
lines.ko: 네. 그러고 나서 호스로 물을 줄 거예요.

lines.en: Good. My small pot needs water too.
lines.ko: 좋아요. 제 작은 화분도 물이 필요해요.
